text:
Didier Deschamps turns down Manchester United offer to replace Michael Carrick - Paper Talk
Plus: Shea Lacey is set to be handed his full Man Utd debut vs Aston Villa; Bryson DeChambeau has been offered a free route back by the DP World Tour after LIV Golf fails; James Anderson is in talks with Surrey to continue his county career
Thursday 5 November 2026 23:10, UK
The top stories and transfer rumours from Friday's newspapers...
MAN UTD NEWS
Didier Deschamps has told Manchester United he has no interest in becoming their next manager - Daily Mirror
Manchester United co-owner Avram Glazer has claimed the club's value is not dependent on success on the pitch - The Athletic
Shea Lacey is set to be handed a full Premier League debut for Manchester United's must-win game against Aston Villa - talkSPORT
- Transfer Centre LIVE! | Latest on YOUR PL club!
- Got Sky? Watch LIVE football on your phone📱
- Not got Sky? Get Sky Sports or stream with no contract on NOW
PREMIER LEAGUE
Tottenham are set to welcome back Xavi Simons and Savio from the pair's respective injuries - Evening Standard
The deal for a group of billionaires to buy a minority stake in Liverpool remains on track to pass a deadline set by the new independent football regulator - Daily Mail
Daniel Levy and Joe Lewis are battling it out to buy a London team in NBA Europe - The Sun
FIFA wants talks with the International Olympic Committee over restricting the Olympic women's football tournament to U23s owing to concerns over fixture congestion and the workload of senior players - The Guardian
Andria Bartishvili, a future Arsenal player, will be sidelined for up to three months with an ankle injury - Evening Standard
OTHER SPORTS
Bryson DeChambeau has been offered a free route back to the professional game by the DP World Tour after LIV Golf confirmed that it was shutting down - Daily Telegraph
James Anderson is in talks with Surrey to continue his county career - The Guardian
Daniel Dubois is eying a return to the ring in January 2027, his promoter Frank Warren revealed - The Sun
Betfred has gone through with its promise to pull sponsorship of all five British Classics, including the Derby, following Labour's attack on gambling in the Budget - Daily Telegraph
digest_he:
מאמן נבחרת צרפת דידייה דשאן הבהיר למנצ'סטר יונייטד כי אינו מעוניין להתמנות למאמן הקבוצה הבא. במקביל, שחקן הצעיר שיי לייסי צפוי לערוך את הופעת הבכורה בהרכב הפותח במשחק הקרוב מול אסטון וילה.

בגזרות ספורט אחרות, המועדון האירופי טוטנהאם צפוי לקבל בחזרה את שחקניו הפצועים, וגארפילד דה-שאמבו קיבל הצעה לחזור לסבב המקצועני לאחר סגירת פעילות של LIV גולף.
